description: Send the user’s chosen action or dialogue to Teasa inference. Replies automatically use the language saved by start_story; no language parameter is needed on later turns. Pass the guestSession from start_story unless connected with OAuth. Uses their guest or signed-in Teasa allowance. Reuse clientMessageId and identical input on retries. Never invent or submit a user action without their instruction. A pending turn must be polled with get_turn; do not send another message to finish it.

guestSession.description: Restricted guest credential returned by start_story. Retain privately and pass on every later call, retry and page. Never put it in a URL.

name: send_message
title: Reply in a Teasa story
